prompt: Where is the data about TSL connection stored in the htpps request
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly explains that TLS (labeled TSL) negotiation data is established and observable in the TLS handshake/record layer, not in standard HTTPS request headers/body. Candidate 2 is partly relevant but includes likely hallucinations about specific HTTP headers (e.g., SSL-Session) that are not generally present/standard. Candidates 3 and 4 both incorrectly claim TLS details like cipher suite/version/cert info are stored in HTTP headers or cookies, which is not true in normal HTTPS traffic; they confuse TLS handshake content with HTTP fields.
